Name: Harvey Marriage Expansion REVAMP
Author: Azurysu
Description:
[color=#ffd966][size=4]Please, check out the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2542?tab=description] original mod by Tarlonniel[/url]! This is a revamp of this one, since the author said they'd be discontinuing the mod.
[/size]--------[/color]
This mods is exactly as the original one! It adds nineteen new post-marriage lines and a brand new 12 heart event. Everything is as in the original mod, but since Tarlonniel said they'd be discontinuing it, I decided to rework it a bit and update it for 1.6.

[i]The mod has been reworked to work with i18n, so translations can be directly added to the main mod's files! If you wish to add a new translation you did for the original mod or wish to do a new one, please send me a DM or say it in the posts section. I'd love to have more languages in it!

[/i][color=#6aa84f][b]Current languages inside the revamp mod:[/b][/color]

English - Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Tarlonniel?gameId=1303]Tarlonniel[/url] for the original mod!
Spanish﻿ - I made it myself! :)﻿


[b][color=#6aa84f]REQUIREMENTS
[/color][/b]You need SMAPI and Content Patcher. It's fully compatible with 1.6.

[color=#6aa84f][b]COMPATIBILITY WITH OTHER MODS
[/b][/color]This mod should work fine with any other mod that adds more Harvey content; but it could overlap and may not appear if other mods are overwriting what Harvey Marriage Expansion Revamp's tweaks (marriage dialogue and a 12h event), so I'd say to be careful with that. I'm working to make it fully compatible with my own mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32138]Plus Alive Harvey![/url]

[b][color=#6aa84f]ERROR/BUG REPORTING
[/color][/b]This mod has been updated to work with the latest update of the game, but if you find any error/bug, please don't hesitate to reach out to me to fix it!
